site.notes: Lake parameters are for the entire lake. Data are from the North Dakota Department of Game and Fish: http://gf.nd.gov/gnf/maps/fishing/lakecontours/devilslakeoverview2012.pdf

dataset.datasetnotes: Samples from depths 700-744 are from a short core matched lithologically with the long core. The short core was published in Jacobson & Engstrom (1989). The long core has not been published. Data made available by Heather Almquist.

collectionunit.notes: Composite of a short and long core.

chronology.notes:
Based on the IntCal13 calibration curve. Two separate Bacon age models were done. The first age model included all age controls; however, the fit for the surface core was poor. Ages from this age model were assigned to all samples ≥750 cm depth. The second age model incuded only the core top and lead-210 dates; these ages were assigned to depths 700-744 cm. 

Age Model 1 Bacon command line: Bacon('CREELBAY',thick=30,acc.mean=8,d.max=3077,depths.file=TRUE)

Age Model 1 Bacon settings file:
700 #d.min
3077 #d.max
1 #d.by
1 #depths.file
NA #slump
8 #acc.mean
1.5 #acc.shape
0.7 #mem.mean
4 #mem.strength

1000 #hiatus.mean

cm #unit

site.sitedescription: Very large closed basin, ice-thrust lake, which lies in a preglacial valley. Water level has varied dramatically during the historical period. Creel Bay has a maximum depth of about 15 m.
